response.justification: While Bogdan is an exceptionally capable full-stack engineer with strong staff-level leadership credentials and TypeScript/cloud experience, he does not meet the core minimum requirement of 8+ years building and shipping production-grade AI solutions. His recent work at re:cinq (4 months) contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling is relevant but insufficient to substitute for the required deep AI expertise. Critical gaps include no demonstrated Python proficiency, absence of data pipeline/vector database/RAG experience, and no evidence of LLM model development or optimization work essential for this staff-level AI engineering position.
strengths: Proven staff-level leadership with multiple senior roles, extensive technical mentoring through workshops and courses, and demonstrated ability to architect complex full-stack systems
Strong TypeScript and cloud platform foundation (AWS CDK, Node.js) with clear experience designing system integrations and working with enterprise infrastructure
Recent exposure to AI infrastructure domains (MCP protocols, agentic workflows) demonstrates capability and initiative to engage with emerging AI-focused engineering
concerns: Critical experience gap: only 4 months of AI-related work versus explicit 8+ year minimum requirement; background is primarily full-stack/infrastructure engineering rather than AI/ML development
Missing Python expertise (required primary language) and no demonstrated experience with data science stack, ML frameworks, or algorithm development
Lacks demonstrated expertise in essential AI domains: vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM frameworks, data pipeline engineering, and LLM performance metrics optimization
